QuestInfo.name: Misplaced Tourist
QuestInfo.0: Mr. Yoo at the Golden Temple looks awfully flustered.
QuestInfo.1: Mr. Yoo has 20,000 tourists to send back home now that the Golden Temple has been declared a danger zone. Unfortunately, a girl is missing! She was last seen with #bTthaya#k.\nMr. Yoo said that Tthaya and the tourist might be lost and told you to retrieve the #bGPS TourGuide#k that #b#o8144001##k took before going with Tthaya.
QuestInfo.2: Mr. Yoo has 20,000 tourists to send back home now that the Golden Temple has been declared a danger zone. Unfortunately, a girl is missing! She was last seen with #bTthaya#k.\nYou retrieved the GPS TourGuide and met with Tthaya in the #m252010200#.

0.0: Whoops, this isn't good. \r\n#L0##bWhat's not good?#l\n#k
0.1: We're evacuating all the tourists because of the recent chaos, and I think I may have misplaced one of them. If something happens to her, my butt is so fired.

yes.0: #bTthaya#k was acting as tour guide, so you'll want to talk to her first. Oh, and Tthaya's not good with directions, so you'll want to have a #bGPS TourGuide#k on you when you talk to her. My last one was stolen by a #b#o8144001##k, but maybe you can retrieve it. \n\n#i4033177# #b#t4033177#

no.0: The clock's ticking and there's no sign of the missing girl. I hope she wasn't eaten by monkeys...

1.0: Eep! I don't know you! But you have a GPS TourGuide? What's going on?! Oh man, I'm in so much trouble. So much trouble!
